messages:
alex: @priya taking over primary now — handing off for the 12:00–20:00 UTC window. :wave:
alex: Primary: alex (now)
alex: Secondary: priya (on-call for questions, not primary pager)
alex: Coverage gap: APAC evening overlap looks thin — no dedicated APAC secondary tonight. flagging for follow-up.
alex: Quick perms checklist before I sign off:
- PagerDuty: full responder + ability to escalate to SRE escalation policy
- AWS: assume-role into account "redwood-prod" with iam:PassRole allowed for the oncall role
- Grafana: read + alert acknowledge on dashboards in team/org:infra
- KMS: decrypt access for service-runbooks key (only if you need to rotate secrets) :lock:

alex: Runbooks / links: https://go/redwood/runbooks/oncall-handoff (use the blue button for soc-level checks)

priya: thanks — quick note, I don't currently have Grafana alert-ack permissions in the APAC org. I can read dashboards but can't acknowledge alerts.
priya: Is that a Grafana org setting or a role mapping we request?

sam: Grafana is RBAC via Okta group sync. To get alert-ack you need to be in group `infra-oncall-ack` — raise a short access request to idp-requests with the template: `access: grafana; env: prod; group: infra-oncall-ack; reason: temporary oncall`
sam: It usually takes <30m during business hours. If urgent, ping me and I'll add you manually for the window.

elaine: For PagerDuty, make sure you can see the escalation policy `prod-sre` and trigger runbook links. If you don't see `prod-sre`, open PD and check Services -> prod-api -> Escalation Policy. If missing, it's a PD role issue.

priya: I can see the service but not the escalation policy details (UI shows only "View incidents").

sam: That sounds like PD role = Observer. Need at least `Responder` role on the service. Steps to request via okta ticket (same idp-requests queue). Include service name and exact PD user email.

incident-bot: NOTE: There is 1 active incident in prod-api (INC-2023-112) — currently at triage, assigned to eng-runtime. Affected customers: degraded embeddings throughput in eu-west-1.

alex: On the incident — priority/impact summary in runbook: small percent of production customers see increased 5xxs during bursts. If pager triggers, escalate to SRE then eng-runtime on-call.

alex: Quick commands if you need to assume role in AWS (workstation):
```
# switch to prod account role (aws-vault/SSO)
aws sso login --profile redwood-prod
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOncallRole --role-session-name oncall-session
```

alex: If you get `AccessDenied` on kms:Decrypt, drop the exact error and I'll file an iAM exception request.

priya: filed idp-requests for Grafana ack and PagerDuty responder role. ticket ids: #IDP-4521, #IDP-4522. ETA ~45m.

elaine: For dashboards, here's the short list to bookmark: `infra/alerts`, `prod/latency`, `prod/errors` — if you need quick links ping me and I'll DM them.

sam: If PD escalation is missing and we can't add mid-shift, fallback is to use team contact list in the runbook and call the next-level SRE phone. Phone list in runbook (top of page).

priya: noted. I also don't have KMS decrypt for `service-runbooks` — not opening that ticket unless incidents need secrets rotated.

alex: ok. I'm going offline in 8m. If the idp tickets don't come back before I go, @sam can you stand by to add Grafana manually if needed?

sam: yep I can jump in — if you DM me the user email I'll add it for the window.

alex: thanks all — leaving the channel open for handoff notes. :thumbsup:
ops-runbook-bot: Entry added to handoff log: from alex to priya, window 2023-11-02T12:00Z/2023-11-02T20:00Z, perms flagged: grafana-ack, pd-responder, kms-decrypt.

priya: acknowledged — I'll post another note when idp tickets close or if any alerts fire.

alex: handoff complete — primary changed to priya.
